items.title: Agent Skills (Anthropic official documentation)
items.summary: Anthropic's reference for Agent Skills, which are reusable folders of instructions, metadata and optional scripts or templates that Claude loads on demand when a task is relevant. It explains the SKILL.md structure and where custom skills work: the Claude API, Claude Code and claude.ai.

items.title: UI UX Pro Max
items.summary: An AI skill that helps with UI and UX design across several platforms and frameworks. Its design system generator reads your project requirements and produces a tailored set of recommendations covering page pattern, visual style, colors, typography, key effects and anti-patterns to avoid.

items.title: Awesome Agent Skills (VoltAgent)
items.summary: A curated list of agent skills made by official development teams and community contributors, grouped by publisher. It says the skills work with Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, Windsurf and other agents, and it points to each tool's skill path and documentation.

items.title: awesome-claude-code
items.summary: A curated list of resources for Claude Code, organised into sections such as skills, agents, plugins, status lines, developer tooling, security and memory persistence. It works as a directory to browse, not a single skill.

items.title: wshobson/agents
items.summary: A large collection of plugins, agents, skills and commands for AI coding tools, written once in Markdown in the Claude Code plugin format. Generators adapt it for Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode, Antigravity CLI, GitHub Copilot and Pi. Topics include Python and JavaScript development, code review, testing, infrastructure and security.

items.title: Claude Code Game Studios
items.summary: A repository that turns Claude Code into a game-making setup with many specialised agents and workflow skills. You describe a game idea, answer a few questions, review a one-page brief, and it builds a first playable browser prototype that it checks before handing it over.

items.title: Agentic Awesome Skills
items.summary: A large library of installable SKILL.md playbooks for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and other coding agents. Its AAS Core tool lets an agent search the local catalog, record which skills it chose, and preview a plan before anything in the target project changes.

items.title: i-have-adhd
items.summary: A skill for coding assistants that changes how replies are written. Answers lead with the next action, multi-step tasks are numbered, lists are capped at five items, and preambles, recaps and closing pleasantries are dropped. It is based on ten rules set out in its SKILL.md file.

items.title: Understand Anything
items.summary: A Claude Code plugin that analyzes a project with several cooperating agents and builds a knowledge graph of its files, functions, classes and dependencies. It then opens an interactive dashboard for browsing the graph, searching it, and viewing guided tours. A separate command can also map a markdown knowledge base.

items.title: Agency Agents
items.summary: A collection of specialised AI agent definitions, each with its own domain focus, working style, process and expected deliverables. They can be installed into Claude Code and several other coding tools, either with an install script or by copying a category folder.

items.title: ECC
items.summary: An MIT-licensed toolkit that adds a structured engineering workflow to coding agents: planning, testing, implementation, review, verification and memory, with reusable skills for repeated tasks. It works best with Claude Code and has adapters for other agent tools.

items.title: Modern Web Guidance
items.summary: A set of skills that gives coding agents current web platform knowledge and browser compatibility data. It nudges agents away from older JavaScript-heavy patterns and toward native browser features. It is stewarded by the Chrome, Edge, Firefox and MDN teams together with the web community.

items.title: Graphify
items.summary: A /graphify skill that turns a codebase and its docs, SQL schemas, configs and PDFs into a queryable knowledge graph. Code is parsed locally with deterministic AST parsing. Each connection is labelled as explicitly extracted or inferred, and it uses a graph rather than a vector store.
